description: Use this when the user needs a new SPF record for their email provider. Returns a TXT record ready to publish, or explains what to set up instead when the provider does not need a root SPF include. mailX does not publish it.

domain_name.description: The domain to generate an SPF record for, e.g. example.com

hard_fail_boolean.description: If true, uses strict -all policy (reject unauthorized senders). If false, uses soft ~all (mark but deliver).

provider.description: Email provider identifier. Google Workspace or Gmail = google. Microsoft 365, Office 365 or Outlook = microsoft. Amazon SES = amazon-ses. Common provider names are also accepted.

name: spf_generate
title: SPF Generator
